summary: All five Magnificent Seven companies (Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta, Apple) reported earnings this week — all strong. Apple differentiated itself with capital-light AI strategy vs. competitor heavy CapEx. Samsung remains top smartphone rival but Apple topped Samsung in shipments for first time in 14 years in 2025. Apple CapEx ($4.3B first-half FY2026) vastly lower than Microsoft/Alphabet/Meta AI spend. Some concern Apple AI strategy lags competitors.
